title: Pods (podman)
description: Pods, containers, images and volumes of the pods-boshrelease podman-exporter job (github.com/kinjelom/pods-boshrelease). Requires podman_exporter.enhance_metrics: true (default).

panels.title: Pods running
panels.description: Pods in the running state.

targets.expr: count(podman_pod_state{bosh_deployment=~"$deployment", instance=~"$instance", name=~"$pod"} == 4) or vector(0)

panels.title: Pods not running
panels.description: Pods in any other state than running (degraded = some containers stopped, see the Pods table).

targets.expr: count(podman_pod_state{bosh_deployment=~"$deployment", instance=~"$instance", name=~"$pod"} != 4) or vector(0)

panels.title: Containers running
panels.description: Running containers (infra containers of the pods are not counted).

targets.expr: count(podman_container_state{bosh_deployment=~"$deployment", instance=~"$instance", pod_name=~"$pod", name=~"$container", name!~".+-infra"} == 2) or vector(0)

panels.title: Containers not running
panels.description: Containers in any other state than running.

targets.expr: count(podman_container_state{bosh_deployment=~"$deployment", instance=~"$instance", pod_name=~"$pod", name=~"$container", name!~".+-infra"} != 2) or vector(0)

panels.title: Unhealthy containers
panels.description: Containers whose health check (liveness/startup probe) fails.

targets.expr: count(podman_container_health{bosh_deployment=~"$deployment", instance=~"$instance", pod_name=~"$pod", name=~"$container", name!~".+-infra"} == 1) or vector(0)

panels.title: Restarts
panels.description: Container restarts in the selected time range (changes of the container start time: restartPolicy, failing liveness probe). A pod replayed by monit gets new containers and is not counted here.

targets.expr: sum(changes(podman_container_started_seconds{bosh_deployment=~"$deployment", instance=~"$instance", pod_name=~"$pod", name=~"$container", name!~".+-infra"}[$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Pods
panels.description: One row per pod (a `pods` job definition). Containers include the infra container.

targets.expr: max by (bosh_deployment, instance, name) (podman_pod_state{bosh_deployment=~"$deployment", instance=~"$instance", name=~"$pod"})
max by (bosh_deployment, instance, name) (podman_pod_containers{bosh_deployment=~"$deployment", instance=~"$instance", name=~"$pod"})
max by (bosh_deployment, instance, name) (time() - podman_pod_created_seconds{bosh_deployment=~"$deployment", instance=~"$instance", name=~"$pod"})

panels.title: Pod state
panels.description: State of the pods over time.

targets.expr: max by (instance, name) (podman_pod_state{bosh_deployment=~"$deployment", instance=~"$instance", name=~"$pod"})

panels.title: Containers
panels.description: Uptime is 0 for containers that are not running. Restarts: in the selected time range. Memory limit: `resources.limits.memory`, without a limit the VM memory.

targets.expr: max by (bosh_deployment, instance, pod_name, name, image, ports) (podman_container_state{bosh_deployment=~"$deployment", instance=~"$instance", pod_name=~"$pod", name=~"$container", name!~".+-infra"})

max by (bosh_deployment, instance, pod_name, name, image, ports) (podman_container_health{bosh_deployment=~"$deployment", instance=~"$instance", pod_name=~"$pod", name=~"$container", name!~".+-infra"})

max by (bosh_deployment, instance, pod_name, name, image, ports) ((time() - podman_container_started_seconds{bosh_deployment=~"$deployment", instance=~"$instance", pod_name=~"$pod", name=~"$container", name!~".+-infra"}) * (podman_container_state{bosh_deployment=~"$deployment", instance=~"$instance", pod_name=~"$pod", name=~"$container", name!~".+-infra"} == bool 2))

max by (bosh_deployment, instance, pod_name, name, image, ports) (changes(podman_container_started_seconds{bosh_deployment=~"$deployment", instance=~"$instance", pod_name=~"$pod", name=~"$container", name!~".+-infra"}[$__range]))

max by (bosh_deployment, instance, pod_name, name, image, ports) (podman_container_exit_code{bosh_deployment=~"$deployment", instance=~"$instance", pod_name=~"$pod", name=~"$container", name!~".+-infra"})

max by (bosh_deployment, instance, pod_name, name, image, ports) (rate(podman_container_cpu_seconds_total{bosh_deployment=~"$deployment", instance=~"$instance", pod_name=~"$pod", name=~"$container", name!~".+-infra"}[$__rate_interval]))

max by (bosh_deployment, instance, pod_name, name, image, ports) (podman_container_mem_usage_bytes{bosh_deployment=~"$deployment", instance=~"$instance", pod_name=~"$pod", name=~"$container", name!~".+-infra"})

max by (bosh_deployment, instance, pod_name, name, image, ports) (podman_container_mem_usage_bytes{bosh_deployment=~"$deployment", instance=~"$instance", pod_name=~"$pod", name=~"$container", name!~".+-infra"} / podman_container_mem_limit_bytes{bosh_deployment=~"$deployment", instance=~"$instance", pod_name=~"$pod", name=~"$container", name!~".+-infra"})
max by (bosh_deployment, instance, pod_name, name, image, ports) (podman_container_pids{bosh_deployment=~"$deployment", instance=~"$instance", pod_name=~"$pod", name=~"$container", name!~".+-infra"})

panels.title: Container health
panels.description: Health check results over time (liveness/startup probes run by the pod supervisor).

targets.expr: max by (instance, name) (podman_container_health{bosh_deployment=~"$deployment", instance=~"$instance", pod_name=~"$pod", name=~"$container", name!~".+-infra"})

panels.title: CPU usage
panels.description: CPU time per second (1 = one full core).

targets.expr: sum by (instance, name) (rate(podman_container_cpu_seconds_total{bosh_deployment=~"$deployment", instance=~"$instance", pod_name=~"$pod", name=~"$container", name!~".+-infra"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Memory usage
panels.description: Memory usage of the container cgroup (includes page cache).

targets.expr: sum by (instance, name) (podman_container_mem_usage_bytes{bosh_deployment=~"$deployment", instance=~"$instance", pod_name=~"$pod", name=~"$container", name!~".+-infra"})

panels.title: Memory usage / limit
panels.description: Usage relative to `resources.limits.memory` (without a limit: to the VM memory). Near 100% the kernel OOM-kills the container.

targets.expr: max by (instance, name) (podman_container_mem_usage_bytes{bosh_deployment=~"$deployment", instance=~"$instance", pod_name=~"$pod", name=~"$container", name!~".+-infra"} / podman_container_mem_limit_bytes{bosh_deployment=~"$deployment", instance=~"$instance", pod_name=~"$pod", name=~"$container", name!~".+-infra"})

panels.title: Processes
panels.description: Number of processes/threads (pids) in the container.

targets.expr: sum by (instance, name) (podman_container_pids{bosh_deployment=~"$deployment", instance=~"$instance", pod_name=~"$pod", name=~"$container", name!~".+-infra"})

panels.title: Network traffic (per pod)
panels.description: Received (up) and transmitted (down) bytes/s. The containers of a pod share its network namespace, so traffic is shown per pod; a `hostNetwork: true` pod reports the traffic of the whole VM.

targets.expr: max by (instance, pod_name) (rate(podman_container_net_input_total{bosh_deployment=~"$deployment", instance=~"$instance", pod_name=~"$pod", pod_name!=""}[$__rate_interval]))
max by (instance, pod_name) (rate(podman_container_net_output_total{bosh_deployment=~"$deployment", instance=~"$instance", pod_name=~"$pod", pod_name!=""}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Block I/O
panels.description: Bytes/s read (up) and written (down) by the container (cgroup block I/O).

targets.expr: sum by (instance, name) (rate(podman_container_block_input_total{bosh_deployment=~"$deployment", instance=~"$instance", pod_name=~"$pod", name=~"$container", name!~".+-infra"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum by (instance, name) (rate(podman_container_block_output_total{bosh_deployment=~"$deployment", instance=~"$instance", pod_name=~"$pod", name=~"$container", name!~".+-infra"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Network errors and drops (per pod)
panels.description: Received and transmitted packets/s that were dropped or failed.

targets.expr: max by (instance, pod_name) (rate(podman_container_net_input_errors_total{bosh_deployment=~"$deployment", instance=~"$instance", pod_name=~"$pod", pod_name!=""}[$__rate_interval]) + rate(podman_container_net_input_dropped_total{bosh_deployment=~"$deployment", instance=~"$instance", pod_name=~"$pod", pod_name!=""}[$__rate_interval]) + rate(podman_container_net_output_errors_total{bosh_deployment=~"$deployment", instance=~"$instance", pod_name=~"$pod", pod_name!=""}[$__rate_interval]) + rate(podman_container_net_output_dropped_total{bosh_deployment=~"$deployment", instance=~"$instance", pod_name=~"$pod", pod_name!=""}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Writable layer size
panels.description: Size of the container's writable (top) layer: data written outside volumes/hostPaths. Refreshed every `podman_exporter.cache_duration` (1h), 0 for containers created since the last refresh.

targets.expr: max by (instance, name) (podman_container_rw_size_bytes{bosh_deployment=~"$deployment", instance=~"$instance", pod_name=~"$pod", name=~"$container", name!~".+-infra"})

panels.title: Images
panels.description: Images in the podman storage of the instance. Unused images are not removed by the release.

targets.expr: max by (bosh_deployment, instance, repository, tag, id) (podman_image_size{bosh_deployment=~"$deployment", instance=~"$instance"})
max by (bosh_deployment, instance, repository, tag, id) (time() - podman_image_created_seconds{bosh_deployment=~"$deployment", instance=~"$instance"})

panels.title: Volumes
panels.description: Named volumes (PersistentVolumeClaims). hostPath volumes are not podman volumes.

targets.expr: max by (bosh_deployment, instance, name, driver, mount_point) (podman_volume_info{bosh_deployment=~"$deployment", instance=~"$instance"})

panels.title: Instances
panels.description: Versions per instance and Errors: the number of exporter collectors that failed in the last scrape.

targets.expr: max by (bosh_deployment, instance, podman) (label_replace(podman_system_api_version{bosh_deployment=~"$deployment", instance=~"$instance"}, "podman", "$1", "version", "(.*)"))
max by (bosh_deployment, instance, runtime) (label_replace(podman_system_runtime_version{bosh_deployment=~"$deployment", instance=~"$instance"}, "runtime", "$1", "version", "(.*)"))
max by (bosh_deployment, instance, conmon) (label_replace(podman_system_conmon_version{bosh_deployment=~"$deployment", instance=~"$instance"}, "conmon", "$1", "version", "(.*)"))
max by (bosh_deployment, instance, exporter) (label_replace(prometheus_podman_exporter_build_info{bosh_deployment=~"$deployment", instance=~"$instance"}, "exporter", "$1", "version", "(.*)"))
sum by (bosh_deployment, instance) (1 - podman_scrape_collector_success{bosh_deployment=~"$deployment", instance=~"$instance"})

panels.title: Collector duration
panels.description: Time spent by each collector per scrape (podman API calls).

targets.expr: max by (instance, collector) (podman_scrape_collector_duration_seconds{bosh_deployment=~"$deployment", instance=~"$instance"})
